theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Fact from Fiction
body: Mutual funds aren't just for rich investors. Low minimum investments make them accessible to everyone. Diversification reduces risk through spreading across many securities.
caption: Many believe mutual funds require huge capital or guarantee returns. Reality: They offer flexibility, professional management, and accessible entry points for all investors. Start your learning journey today. #MutualFundMyths #InvestingBasics #FinancialLiteracy #DemystifyingInvestments #SmartInvesting
